page_title: EIN 1-0 DAR | Eintracht Frankfurt v Darmstadt 20/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a yellow card.
90+5' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

90+4' Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Marcel Schuhen thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
90+2' Problems for Torsten Lieberknecht as Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Bartol Franjic replaces him.
90+2' Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
90+1' The game is interrupted now, Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
88' Harm Osmers blows his whistle after Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Eintracht Frankfurt will take a free kick.
86' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

85' Filip Stojilkovic (Darmstadt) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Kevin Trapp!
84' The referee signals a substitution. Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is brought on as a substitute for Randal Kolo Muani.
84' It will be a substitution. Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) is ready to enter the pitch as Mario Gotze walks off.
84' Dino Toppmoller has decided to substitute Jesper Lindstrom and he is replaced by Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt).
83' That's a well-taken pass by Fabian Schnellhardt (Darmstadt). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
82' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar.
79' Fabian Schnellhardt clips a neat ball into the box towards Braydon Marvin Manu (Darmstadt), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
78' Randal Kolo Muani (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
78' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) prepares to take a corner kick.
77' Substitution. Fabian Schnellhardt (Darmstadt) in, Matej Maglica out.
77' Torsten Lieberknecht decides to make a substitution. Marvin Mehlem will be replaced by Braydon Marvin Manu (Darmstadt).
75' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
74' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Harm Osmers had an easy-decision to make.
72' 8:7 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. 3:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
70' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
68' Jesper Lindstrom (Eintracht Frankfurt) connects with a loose ball in the box, but sends his first-time shot miles past the left post.

66' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the left post! Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) finds his way to a rebound inside the six-yard box thanks to his strength and unleashes a strike towards goal, but it ricochets away off one of his teammates. Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) gets to the rebound but blows his chance to score with a header from a dangerous position inside the box. His effort floats high over the bar.
65' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) will take the corner.
65' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Makoto Hasebe comes onto the pitch to replace him.
65' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
63' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
62' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) replacing Fraser Hornby.
62' A substitution has been made. Oscar Vilhelmsson goes off and Filip Stojilkovic (Darmstadt) comes on.
59' Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to Kristijan Jakic (Eintracht Frankfurt) for his blatant foul.

57' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) wasted a huge opportunity! He received a fine cross from the free kick and fired a decent shot in from close range. Unfortunately for him, it sailed just over the crossbar! Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) is adjudged offside.
55' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) is quick to pick up the loose pass from Marvin Mehlem. He tries his luck from mid-range, but it goes well wide of the right post.
53' A pass from Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) is intercepted by Kevin Trapp and the move breaks down.
53' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar.
53' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

52' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a corner kick.
51' The corner kick from Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

51' Jesper Lindstrom (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Randal Kolo Muani (Eintracht Frankfurt) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
48' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) makes a strong challenge and Harm Osmers blows for a foul.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Marcel Schuhen.
45+1' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a long ball forward to Junior Dina Ebimbe, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
40' 1 - 0 Goal! Philipp Max feeds Randal Kolo Muani (Eintracht Frankfurt), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 1:0.
39' William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Darmstadt.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) was quite harsh and Harm Osmers didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

36' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Marcel Schuhen was alert and the score remained the same.
36' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

35' Randal Kolo Muani (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
33' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Fraser Hornby (Darmstadt) inside the box.
30' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
30' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) commits a rough foul. Harm Osmers stops the game and makes a call. That's a free kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
28' Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Kevin Trapp makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the top left corner.
23' A cooling break is underway.
21' Kristijan Jakic (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
21' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

20' Jesper Lindstrom (Eintracht Frankfurt) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
18' Eintracht Frankfurt take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

17' Randal Kolo Muani (Eintracht Frankfurt) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
15' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
14' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first. The referee points to the corner flag and Darmstadt will take a corner.
14' William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Darmstadt will take a free kick near the side line.
12' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marcel Schuhen intercepts the ball.
10' Kristijan Jakic (Eintracht Frankfurt) is penalised for a foul. Harm Osmers had a clear view and blows his whistle.
7' Fraser Hornby (Darmstadt) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

6' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
6' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Sebastian Rode (Eintracht Frankfurt) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Kristijan Jakic.
5' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. It's a throw-in for Eintracht Frankfurt.
2' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Eintracht Frankfurt will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Harm Osmers.
